name: panel-audit
description: Two-stage fact-checking for multi-model councils on non-code work. run-panel dispatches seats in parallel, enforces a tooling gate (a seat that asserts facts must have research access), and returns seat reports on disk plus a claim ledger the seats produce themselves. The chair writes the deliverable, then verify-claims takes the ledger entries that survived into it and fans out tool-equipped verifiers in parallel, returning per-claim confirmed/wrong/imprecise/unverifiable with sources. An intermediate document is treated as a claim, not a source. Ships the working-with-panels skill, the run-panel and verify-claims workflows, the claim-verifier and panel-auditor agents, and an audit-summary hook backstop.
